sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 is the official release of DeepSeek-V4-Flash, superseding the preview version, with substantially enhanced agentic capabilities. It has the same model structure as DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark, i.e. it comes with a speculative decoding module attached.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 is a sparse mixture-of-experts text generation model with 13B active parameters out of 284B total, supporting a 1M-token context window. The re-post-trained revision is suited for coding, reasoning, and agent workflows. It is available under the MIT license as an open-weights model.
